ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024); Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information issued jointly by the People's Bank of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation (PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended through 2024).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (or equivalent registration certificate) of the ultimate foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or registrar of companies in the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the issuing state is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention: notarize the certificate locally as required, obtain an Apostille certificate from the state's designated Competent Authority, then have the apostilled document translated into Chinese. If the issuing state is not an Apostille party: notarize the certificate, legalize it through the issuing state's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalize it at the PRC Embassy/Consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel alternatives and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (or Certificate of Active Status/Existence) of the ultimate foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar or designated government authority in the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Use the Apostille route only when the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention member; otherwise use the Consular route through the local Ministry of Foreign Affairs and PRC Embassy/Consulate. No additional PRC consular stamp is added after an Apostille certificate, and no Apostille is added to a consularized document. The authenticated certificate must be translated into Chinese before filing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the ultimate foreign shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the WFOE and Power of Attorney appointing the local representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign shareholder, notarized by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the board resolution and Power of Attorney in the shareholder's jurisdiction, then either obtain an Apostille certificate if the jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention member or subject the documents to consular legalization at the PRC Embassy/Consulate if the jurisdiction is not a member. The two authentication systems are mutually exclusive and must be applied in one path only, never as a chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the proposed China WFOE (pre-signed by the ultimate foreign shareholder) together with a certified copy of the foreign shareholder's existing constitutional documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign shareholder for execution; local notary and certified translator for attestation; company registry for the shareholder's constitutional document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The foreign shareholder's existing constitutional document must be notarized and then either apostilled or consular legalized depending on the issuer's Apostille Convention status. The proposed WFOE Articles of Association are executed in Chinese and English at closing and do not require foreign authentication, but must be filed with SAMR through the electronic registration system.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the ultimate foreign shareholder's principal bank confirming account standing and transaction history
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank issuing the letter and the responsible bank officer; local notary if required
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank reference letter must be notarized at the issuing bank or local notary and then authenticated through either the Hague Apostille path (if the bank's jurisdiction is an Apostille member) or consular legalization path (if not). The authenticated letter is then translated into Chinese and presented to the Chinese bank and relevant authorities; the two authentication routes are parallel and must not be sequentially chained.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any filing, every shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner, director, supervisor, general manager, and authorized signatory must be screened against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC specially designated nationals list, PRC Ministry of Public Security fugitive and sanctioned lists, SAMR restricted registration database, and EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons from any jurisdiction, including domestic PRC PEPs, their family members, and close associates. Continuous screening must be repeated within 48 hours of filing and upon every corporate event until incorporation is complete. Negative hits require internal escalation and a written compliance conclusion.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Registration and Verification Portal, integrated with the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A PRC company name must be formed and recorded exclusively in simplified Chinese characters, composed of four tiers: administrative division, distinctive name/trade name, industry/characteristics, and company form. Where the foreign investor's corporate name includes a Roman-script name, the Chinese name must use a standardized phonetic transliteration adopted from the foreign parent's registered name; the English name is not a certified component and may be used in contracts only after registration. Use of Group, Holding, or International may require additional scale evidence and ministerial-level prior approval.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 10 business days of a name-rejection notice, the applicant may resubmit an amended name through the same SAMR online portal, adding a written explanation and supporting evidence of distinctiveness, including trademark registration certificates, parent-company name certificates, or lease evidence. If the rejection is sustained, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration with the municipal people's government or SAMR's next higher level within 60 days of actual receipt. If reconsideration fails, an administrative lawsuit may be initiated within six months.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mailbox without a real lease is not permissible as the registered address of a WFOE. Market Supervision and tax authorities require a physical business-use premises in China, evidenced by a lease contract, owner's certificate, or property certificate, and the same address must appear on the business license. A commercial mailbox cannot receive original invoices or tax audits. Some free-trade-zone one-address-multiple-license schemes permit shared workstations, but banks still require site inspection and proof that the WFOE actually controls the premises. For ISIC 5210 kitting/fulfillment, the premises must permit actual storage, assembly, safety, and export operations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Physical on-site inspection is likely and should be assumed. Checklist: original lease, prepaid rent receipt, utility bill, site signage, inventory kitting records, staffing roster, safety equipment, production line, and records of logistics dispatch. Quantified risk: approximately 20-25% in the first 18 months for newly registered WFOEs in 3PL fulfillment; tax and SAMR may carry out unannounced inspections when value-added tax invoices exceed declared scale or when the registered address is co-located with another company. Maintain a permanent employee at the site and preserve the lease for at least five years.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (Revised 2023, effective 1 July 2024), particularly Articles 1-29 (formation and registration), Articles 32-40 (registered capital and contribution rules), Articles 46-52 (organizational structure of the limited liability company), Articles 74-85 (duties of directors and officers), and the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Foreign-Invested Enterprises as interpreted in conjunction with the Foreign Investment Law (2019) and its Implementing Regulations, along with the Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746, as amended).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation with jurisdiction over the registered address; foreign investment information reporting is concurrently filed with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) via the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Establishment of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (企业设立登记申请书) accompanied by the Articles of Association, the Foreign Investor's Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing, the Registered Office Lease or Certificate of Title, the Capital Contribution Confirmation, the Power of Attorney for the filing agent, and the appointment documents for the legal representative, executive director, supervisors and general manager; filing of the Foreign Investment Information Report (外商投资信息报告) through the integrated SAMR one-stop portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under the Company Law for an ordinary light industrial/fulfillment services WFOE; the registered capital is an subscribed amount recorded in the Articles of Association and must be contributed by the shareholder(s) within the period specified in the Articles, not exceeding five years from establishment for general enterprises; no blocked escrow account is required by statute. The amount should nevertheless be commercially reasonable to support the business scale, foreign exchange registration with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), banking limits, licensing and customs/bonded logistics arrangements; for a fulfillment/kitting operation, an indicative subscribed capital of RMB 500,000 or more is recommended, though no minimum legal floor applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [●] CO., LTD. (WFOE). The undersigned, being the duly appointed executive director and/or the members of the first board of directors of [●] Co., Ltd., a wholly foreign-owned enterprise duly organized under the laws of the People's Republic of China, acting pursuant to the provisions of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Articles of Association of the Company as adopted on the date of incorporation, do hereby adopt the following resolutions on [●], 2025 at [●] (local time) at [●], being the principal place of business of the Company. 1. SUBSCRIPTION AND CONFIRMATION OF SHARE CAPITAL: RESOLVED, that the issuance and subscription of the registered capital of the Company be, and hereby is, ratified and confirmed in accordance with the Articles of Association. The shareholder shall contribute the subscribed capital in the amount and currency and within the timeframes set forth in the capital contribution schedule appended to the Articles of Association, and the executive director shall cause such capital contributions to be recorded in the Company's books and accounts, to be verified by a duly licensed certified public accountant where required by law. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company, as stated in the certificate of incorporation and lease documents, be, and hereby is, adopted and approved as the principal administrative headquarters and statutory seat of the Company; that the executive director and the general manager are authorized to execute any lease, license, amendment, renewal, and utility agreement ancillary to the occupation and maintenance of such registered office; and that any subsequent relocation shall be subject to a further resolution of the shareholders or board as required by the Articles of Association. 3. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED, that the Company shall open demand deposit accounts and such other accounts as may be necessary with one or more banks authorized to conduct foreign exchange settlement business in the People's Republic of China, including a RMB basic deposit account, a foreign currency capital account, and such operating and collection accounts as may be required for its fulfillment, kitting, and assembly business; that the executive director, general manager, and designated finance officers shall be, and hereby are, appointed as lone signatories or dual signatories per the bank's mandate; and that the corporate chop, financial chop, and legal representative's signature shall be affixed or applied in accordance with the bank's specimen card. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS: RESOLVED, that [●] be and hereby is appointed as Executive Director and Legal Representative, that [●] be and hereby is appointed as Supervisor, and that [●] be and hereby is appointed as General Manager of the Company, each to serve until removed, resigned, or re-elected in accordance with the Articles of Association and the Company Law; that such officers shall have the authority, jointly and severally as provided herein and in the Articles, to execute all election filings, tax registrations, social insurance registrations, customs registrations, foreign exchange registrations and such other registrations as may be necessary or advisable; and that each such officer is entitled to rely upon the advice of legal counsel and accountants in the performance of their duties. 5. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION AND INDEMNITY: RESOLVED, that the officers of the Company be, and hereby are, authorized to prepare, execute, seal, deliver, and file all certificates, forms, notices, agreements, and undertakings necessary to effectuate the forgoing resolutions and to carry on the Company's business in the ordinary course; that the Company shall indemnify each officer and director to the fullest extent permitted by law against all losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses incurred in good faith in connection with the performance of duties; and that the adoption of this resolution shall be effective immediately upon execution, and a certified copy shall be retained in the corporate minute book. The foregoing resolutions were duly adopted and approved on the date first written above.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Reservation Through the One-Stop SAMR Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online one-stop platform (企业开办一网通办 portal) at the municipal district level where the registered office is to be located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Chinese and English trade names of the proposed WFOE through the online name pre-approval module, obtained by the authorized filing agent or legal representative. The name must conform to the Administrative Provisions on Enterprise Name Registration (2021) and include a distinctive trade name, industry term, and legal form suffix '有限公司'. The filing agent shall upload the foreign investor's certificate of incorporation with apostille or consular legalization, a power of attorney executed by the sole shareholder, and a digital verification of the proposed Chinese name. If the proposed name contains a geographic prefix, trademark, or sensitive word, additional authorization must be provided. Should the name be rejected due to similarity with an existing mark, the applicant shall select an alternate name or file an opposition with the SAMR within five working days. Upon approval, the name reservation notice is issued with its validity period, which must be captured for subsequent submission.
required_dossiers: Application for pre-approval of enterprise name (one-stop electronic form)
Power of Attorney executed by the foreign sole shareholder to the filing agent
Certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor (apostilled by the competent authority of the country of origin and translated into Chinese by a certified translation agency)
Proof of identity of the appointed legal representative/physical ID copy or passport copy of the designated officer
Letter of authorization for the use of the registered office (preliminary) or land/certificate of title if the property is owned by the investor
Digital scan of the proposed Articles of Association draft for annex review
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried or suspended, the filing agent shall within 2 working days access the SAMR portal's online consultation module, obtain the written rejection reason code, submit a new proposed name with a disclaimer of similarity, or request a manual review before a SAMR officer. A formal reconsideration petition can be filed using Form XX under the Administrative Reconsideration Law of the People's Republic of China if the rejection is arbitrary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Submission of the Establishment Application and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) integrated online one-stop platform; concurrently linked to the Ministry of Commerce foreign investment information reporting system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the final Chinese-language Articles of Association executed by the sole shareholder, together with the SAMR prescribed Application for Registration of Establishment of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company. The application must include the registered capital amount, subscribed contribution schedule, business scope verbatim reflecting ISIC 5210 and NAICS 493110 light value-added fulfillment, kitting and assembly services, the registered address, and the names and identification numbers of the legal representative, executive director, supervisor and general manager. The legal representative must perform facial verification via the SAMR app or the electronic submission interface; the filing agent affixes the digital seal or the electronic signature of the shareholder and the legal representative. The system will generate an acceptance receipt; any incomplete fields are returned immediately with a correction list. The business scope must avoid regulated categories requiring pre-approval; if the submitted scope inadvertently includes a sensitive industry, an amendment shall be filed before submission. After the electronic application is accepted, the system will send a notice to the designated contact for the next step involving original document inspection or the submission of a negative checklist declaration.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration of Establishment of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (system-generated form with electronic signatures)
Articles of Association executed by the sole shareholder in Chinese
Name pre-approval notice (system pull or upload)

Lease agreement for the registered office and the landlord's property title certificate (or real estate license) with a floor plan; or an industrial park's hosting agreement with the park's property certificate
Certificate of incorporation and good standing of the foreign investor (apostilled or consularized, with certified Chinese translation)
Capital contribution schedule confirming the subscribed amount and payment deadline
ID/passport copies of the legal representative, executive director, supervisor, and general manager or finance manager
Consent and appointment documents signed by the sole shareholder for all officers
Form of the resolution of the foreign shareholder (or a sole shareholder's written decision) approving the Articles of Association and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is suspended or queried, the authorized legal representative or agent shall reply through the portal within the prescribed 5-10 working days by uploading amended Articles of Association or supplementary notarized documents. If the SAMR issues a written rectification notice, the applicant has a statutory right to cure within 15 days per Article 12 of the Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities. If the registration is denied, the applicant may file a petition for reconsideration with the next-higher SAMR authority within 60 days or an administrative lawsuit within 6 months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Approval Seal Carving, Bank Account Opening, and Post-Registration Tax/Social Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-authorized seal engraving company; commercial bank with foreign exchange license; local branch of the State Taxation Administration; Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) via the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the business license, the WFOE shall immediately carve the company seal (公章), financial seal (财务专用章), legal representative seal (法定代表人章), tax invoice seal (发票专用章) and contract seal (合同专用章) at a Public Security Bureau-certified engraving shop, carrying the original license and the legal representative's identity proof. Thereafter, the corporate bank account shall be opened at a licensed bank account within 10 working days: a RMB basic deposit account, a foreign currency capital account, and a segregated account for cross-border RMB or foreign exchange receipts. The bank will input the information into the PBOC's account management system and issue a Basic Deposit Account Permit information slip. The tax registration must be completed by accessing the electronic tax bureau within 30 days of the license date, including the tax status as a VAT general taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer, and the finance department must file the accounting record system, invoicing, and payroll ledger. Social insurance, housing fund, and labor contract enrollment must be made through the one-stop municipal portal. SAFE registration of the foreign investor's information must be handled through the opening bank under the 'direct bank processing' model. The logistics fulfillment operation must not receive payments from Chinese mainland counterparties before the tax registration and invoice system are operative.
required_dossiers: Original business license (uniform social credit code certificate) of the WFOE
Company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal, invoice seal after carving with the seal-engraving record certificate
Legal representative's passport/ID and the power of attorney for the bank signatories
Articles of Association and the SAMR registration acceptance receipt
Registered office lease, landlord property certificate, and utility invoice as proof of actual address
Tax registration basic information form and taxpayer qualification questionnaire
Certificate of incorporation of foreign shareholder with apostille and Chinese translation for banking KYC
Resolution of the board or the executive director's decision approving the bank account opening (which can be the first board resolution or a separate sole director's written resolution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses or delays account opening due to KYC queries, the company shall request the bank's refusal grounds in writing, supplement the citizenship/residence proof, execute a compliance declaration, or apply to another licensed bank. Should the tax filing be rejected for an over-limit invoice quota, the taxpayer shall file an adjustment application under the invoice management rules. Failure to receive bank support must be escalated to the local PBOC branch for resolution under the payment settlement regulations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Customs, Logistics Park Registration, and Post-Registration Operating Licenses for Fulfillment/Kitting/Assembly
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: China Customs (local customs house) via the China International Trade Single Window; local commerce authority; municipal market regulation bureau for any subsequent business scope amendment; local postal administration if express-related activities exceed the scope of 3PL fulfillment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a fulfillment, kitting, and light assembly operation engaged in cross-border goods handling, the WFOE shall complete customs registration for customs declaration units through the China International Trade Single Window, obtaining the customs registration code and ten-bit customs code. If the operation uses bonded warehouse or special customs supervision zone services, the company shall execute warehouse lease and bonded entry agreements and submit supporting documents to the customs authority. The company is further required to obtain the 'Export and Import Enterprise Registration Certificate' logic and File a Record of Foreign Trade Operators with the local commerce authority through the Single Window if the fulfillment services require title transfer or export/import declaration in the WFOE's own name. Should the kitting and assembly involve repacking, assembly or postponement production, the local Administration for Market Regulation may require a business scope update to reflect any ancillary production activity, but no separate industrial license is required for ISIC 5210 because it is not classified as a manufacturing industry. For any storage above ordinary commercial warehouse thresholds, an industrial-scale safety filing may be requested by the local emergency management bureau; nevertheless, the operational licenses for general 3PL fulfillment are not mandatory at the central level. The company must complete its annual foreign investment information report and the annual market entity annual report through the SAMR portal prior to 30 June of the following year.
required_dossiers: Customs registration application through the China International Trade Single Window
Foreign Trade Operator Filing Form (对外贸易经营者备案), with the uniform social credit code and company license scan
Lease and custody agreement for the fulfillment warehouse or the bonded zone entry agreement
List of customs declaration agents and declaration clerk qualifications if applicable
The company's business license and the completed seal set

Export/import VAT invoice system is not necessary for pure contract logistics or 3PL services without trading title transfer, but is necessary if the company also acts as principal in the import/export
Tax registration certificate and bank account opening receipt for the customs authority
Confirmation by the warehouse owner of fire safety compliance and the civil defense checklist, if the company leases an existing compliant warehouse
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If customs registration is rejected due to a mismatch in the registered capital or operating address, the applicant shall submit a modification of registration to SAMR before re-filing through the Single Window. If the local commerce authority queries foreign trade operator status, the company shall respond with a written supplementary explanation and revise the detailed action protocol using the direct filing quick channel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Defense, Fire Safety, and Occupational Safety Compliance for Warehouse and Kitting Premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Fire and Rescue Brigade (Fire Department) under the Ministry of Emergency Management; local housing and urban-rural development authority; local emergency management bureau for work safety filings; and the municipal administrative agency for special equipment (if any conveyor or lifting equipment is installed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing warehouse occupancy and kitting operations, the WFOE's landlord or the WFOE itself shall complete a fire safety acceptance inspection on the leased warehouse. Under the Fire Control Law of the People's Republic of China and the Rules on Fire Safety Management of Warehousing Facilities, a warehouse used for packages and kitting materials may require a Fire Safety Record Filing if the floor area exceeds a local threshold, or a Fire Safety Design Approval and Completion Acceptance in cases where the building was newly built or significantly altered. The tenant must secure a fire safety responsibility letter, verify emergency exits, install fire-rated separation for flammable packaging materials, ensure sprinklers and fire alarm system conformity, and appoint a dedicated fire safety manager. Where shelves, conveyors, or lifting platforms are used, the company must register the special equipment with the local market supervision inspection agency before use and undergo annual inspection. For workplace storage of corrugated board, plastic packaging, and other combustibles, quantified limits on storage volume should be defined in the fire safety plan, with a maximum stored mass per storage bay not exceeding the design floor load. Civil defense clearance is obtained by submission of the floor plan, fire protection design statement, fire extinguisher layout, and a safety operations manual to the fire rescue brigade, followed by a site inspection or a filing review. The company must maintain a fire emergency drill record at least annually.
required_dossiers: Fire safety filing/acceptance form for the warehouse or logistics premises
Floor plan indicating exits, extinguishers, hydrants, storage zones and assembly/repacking stations
Landlord's fire safety acceptance certificate for the original building or the fire filing receipt
Fire safety management system and emergency evacuation plan documents
Lease agreement and property ownership certificate
Safety production responsibility system and training records of warehouse staff
Certificates of special operation personnel (e.g., forklift drivers, electrical workers) and special equipment registration certificates
Civil defense and fire insurance proof if the landlord or the municipality requires it
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire filing is rejected or a rectification order is issued, the WFOE shall engage a qualified fire service vendor to perform remediation, take photographs of corrected conditions, and resubmit the rectification report to the fire rescue brigade within the specified period, typically 10 working days. If an administrative penalty is imposed, the company may apply for a restated compliance checklist with the local emergency management bureau and may appeal the penalty under the Administrative Penalty Law. If the special equipment certificate is overdue, operations involving that equipment must be suspended until re-inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable. ISIC 5210 (Warehousing and storage) and NAICS 493110 (General warehousing and storage, including fulfillment center and kitting activities) are classified as a logistics/commercial service activity rather than manufacturing, chemical processing, or hazardous assembly. Therefore, no industrial manufacturing license is required from the local Administration for Market Regulation or the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. If the WFOE expands into repacking with chemical additives, battery handling, or dangerous goods storage, an application must be made to the local Emergency Management Bureau for a Dangerous Goods Storage Permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable for pure light fulfillment/kitting/assembly under ISIC 5210; the core operating authorization is the Market Entity Business License issued by SAMR, supplemented by the Foreign Trade Operator Filing Record (if the WFOE takes principal import/export positions), the Customs Industrial Registration Certificate, the Fire Safety Record Filings, and the warehouse lease under the civil defense compliance framework. The WFOE must not adopt the title 'Manufacturer' or 'Production Enterprise' in its business scope unless it re-classifies under ISIC 2xxx or 3xxx.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE), acting through the local Municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (Exempt from Full EIA Report) for a fulfillment/kitting/assembly operation exclusively involving dry goods, non-chemical packaging, cardboard, plastic film and light assembly of non-hazardous components. A full Environmental Impact Assessment Report (建设项目环境影响报告书) is not required unless the operation installs combustion equipment, spray-painting booths, solvent-based adhesive application lines, or handles dangerous chemicals. If the landlord's warehouse has already obtained its environmental acceptance, the WFOE lessee must only file an environmental registration and submit the 'Self-Disclosure of Environmental Protection Information' through the national EIA filing system; for warehouses below 5,000 square meters with no toxic discharge, the classification is Level III (Registration Form). Should the WFOE add battery kitting or lithium-ion assembly, a project environmental evaluation registration form (Level II) shall be filed before operations commence.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For dry fulfillment, kitting, and light assembly without wet processes, no routine wastewater discharge is generated; sanitary wastewater must be discharged into the municipal sewage network in conformity with the Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard GB 8978-1996 or the local standard, with COD below 100 mg/L and suspended solids below 70 mg/L after municipal pre-treatment where applicable. Non-methane total hydrocarbons (VOCs) from incidental packaging heat-sealing or consumer-goods kitting must comply with the Comprehensive Emission Standards of Air Pollutants GB 16297-1996 and the local volatile-organic-compound control standard, generally with a non-methane total hydrocarbon concentration at the boundary below 4.0 mg/m³ and an emission concentration below 120 mg/m³ for general exhaust outlets; adhesive or heat-seal stations must be equipped with local exhaust ventilation. Hazardous waste (e.g., waste toner cartridges, used battery waste, oily cloths) must be stored in a dedicated closed room with leak-proof containment and disposed of within 90 days through a licensed hazardous waste transporter under the National Hazardous Waste List (2021 edition) and the Hazardous Waste Management Permit system; the WFOE must establish a hazardous waste management ledger and file a hazardous waste transfer manifest with the local ecology and environment bureau. Packaging waste shall be sorted through a licensed recycler, and noise levels at the boundary must not exceed the Class 2 daytime limit of 60 dB(A) and nighttime limit of 50 dB(A) under GB 12348-2008 where the warehouse is located in a mixed industrial/commercial zone. The local bureau will not require a pollutant discharge permit for activities that only produce sanitary sewage and no organized industrial exhaust, but the WFOE should still register an environmental self-declaration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The WFOE must obtain a Fire Safety Filing/Record (ocp: 建设工程消防验收备案/备案抽查) with the local Fire and Rescue Brigade for the leased warehouse premises, accompanied by a Civil Defense completion inspection where the warehouse building is a newly constructed or structurally altered facility. The lessee shall ensure a structural load inspection is performed by a qualified design institute if the kitting floor loads exceed 500 kg/m² or if multi-tier racking is installed; the structural design must show the live load capacity in accordance with the current load code GB 50009-2012. A workplace safety approval is enforced by the local Emergency Management Bureau under the Work Safety Law of the People's Republic of China, with a written responsibility system, 'double prevention' risk classification and control, a full safety training file for all operatives, and a special equipment pre-use inspection for forklifts and hydraulic lift tables under the Special Equipment Safety Law of the People's Republic of China. Worker protection includes a temperature-controlled environment, ergonomic risk controls for kitting tasks, chemical agent safety data sheets if any adhesive or cleaning agent is introduced, and mandatory safety messaging in Chinese. The civil defense certificate is confirmed through the fire acceptance check or the filing receipt, which must be kept on the premises and produced on demand during municipal safety inspections.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); online electronic filing portal is the Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax@China) accessible via https://tpass.chinatax.gov.cn (or provincial e-Tax portals)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) incorporated in mainland China, the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) simultaneously constitutes the Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN). The procurement procedure is: (1) incorporate the WFOE with SAMR and obtain the Business License containing the 18-digit USCC; (2) complete the post-incorporation tax registration within the statutory timeline through the local STA office or the electronic tax bureau, where the USCC is automatically activated as the tax registration ID; (3) register for VAT status (small-scale or general VAT payer) as required; (4) receive confirmation of the tax-supervision relationship with the competent tax authority. For a foreign non-resident entity not incorporated in China but with taxable activity, a simple TIN is obtained through withholding registration at the source or under applicable double-tax-treaty rules; however, the standard WFOE holding the USCC is the normal resident taxpayer structure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (China does not operate a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime). The only relevant election is the VAT payer status option: an entity below the RMB 5,000,000 annual turnover threshold may voluntarily register as a general VAT payer, while entities above the threshold are mandatorily general VAT payers. Additionally, a qualifying WFOE may elect to be treated as a tax-exempt enterprise for small-scale VAT purposes if conditions are met. No corporate tax classification election is available under Chinese law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Annual taxable sales (excluding VAT) exceeding RMB 5,000,000 mandates registration as a general VAT payer; voluntary registration is available below this threshold for entities making taxable supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT taxpayers must use the new Fully Digitalised E-invoice (Shudan Gi) system under the Gold Tax Phase III/IV (Jin San/Jin Si) infrastructure. General VAT payers must issue tax control invoices through the official electronic invoice filing platform, with mandatory real-time upload of invoice data to the STA, automatic cryptographic stamping, and risk-based clearing. The system enforces unified invoice templates, digital signatures, and real-time verification. Taxpayers must maintain a valid Tax Control Device (electronic tax U-Key) or use the free e-invoice platform to issue invoices in accordance with the Announcement on Deepening the Comprehensive Digital Invoice Reform. Non-compliant issuance triggers automatic system rejection and administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods are eligible for zero-rating (i.e., exemption from output VAT with full refund of input VAT) provided the goods are physically exported from mainland China, the exporter is a general VAT payer, the export transaction is genuinely concluded with a non-resident buyer, and the entity files the export declaration with the appropriate customs office. Qualifying goods must meet the statutory conditions set forth in the Interim Regulations on VAT and the relevant Ministry of Finance/STA export rebate policies. The export must be supported by legally effective customs declarations, transportation documents, and foreign exchange receipts. For cross-border services, zero-rating applies only to explicitly enumerated categories; warehousing and kitting services performed domestically for goods subsequently exported are generally treated as taxable domestic services and do not qualify for zero-rating, while the physical goods themselves, when exported, do qualify.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (Export Declaration Form issued by China Customs, with the assigned export customs transaction number)
Bill of Lading (for sea shipments) or Airway Bill (for air shipments) issued by the carrier evidencing international carriage
Bank Foreign Exchange Receipt Voucher (Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank collection confirmation evidencing receipt of export proceeds from the foreign buyer)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unverified export zero-rating claims are subject to immediate clawback of the refunded input VAT, accrued late payment interest at the statutory rate, and administrative fines under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection (PRC Tax Administration Law) and the Customs Law. If the exporter fails to provide the mandatory customs and foreign-exchange documents within the prescribed period, or if the export proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days, the VAT refund is invalidated and the entity must repay the refund with interest, plus a penalty of 0.05% per day on overdue amounts. In cases of deliberate false declaration or fraudulent export refund schemes, criminal liability may be pursued under the Criminal Law for tax evasion, with fines ranging from 50% to five times the amount evaded and custodial penalties for responsible personnel. Additionally, the STA may revoke the general VAT payer status, impose an elevated scrutiny access class for future refunds, and list the entity in the tax dishonesty blacklist with adverse consequences for cross-border trade and financing.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China currently maintains RMB convertibility for current account transactions under the SAFE framework, while capital account transactions remain subject to a registration and approval matrix. A wholly foreign-owned enterprise may freely convert export proceeds and service income in the current account, and may purchase foreign exchange for genuine current account payments without SAFE pre-approval. Capital account transactions, including inbound FDI equity contributions, outbound investment, offshore loans, and profit repatriation, require SAFE registration or filing with the onshore custodian bank. Dividends or profits may be remitted abroad after annual audit and corporate income tax settlement, provided the WFOE has satisfied tax withholding on dividends (10% treaty rate where applicable). No explicit compulsory FX surrender ratio is currently imposed; however, trade-related receipts must be repatriated within the 180-day goods trade verification cycle. Cross-border flow rails are monitored through the bank's RCPMIS and ASOne reporting systems.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory verification and repatriation period: 180 days from customs export declaration. Mandatory conversion: none, as China abolished compulsory FX surrender in 2012; enterprises may retain export proceeds in designated foreign exchange settlement accounts or convert to RMB at any time; banks apply real-demand checks and trade verification through the goods trade monitoring system.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational RMB and Foreign Currency Settlement Account
Trade Settlement and Clearing Account (Current Account)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore digital EMIs are not legally recognized as deposit-taking institutions in mainland China; they cannot open corporate Basic Deposit Accounts or handle foreign capital verification. They may only act as technology-enabled payment processing agents if they hold a PBOC cross-border payment license, but the WFOE must maintain its primary settlement relationship with a licensed domestic commercial bank for all regulated flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The initial corporate account opening for a WFOE requires the statutory legal representative to be physically present at a domestic branch for the face-to-face KYC interview if no authorised resident signatory is appointed. Remote opening through consular proxy is generally not accepted by major state-owned banks for foreign-owned entities; instead, a notarized power of attorney and certified passport copies may permit a locally resident director to attend.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) structure shows a multi-layer holding chain with a tax-neutral jurisdiction, triggering enhanced due diligence on source of wealth and ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A fully notarized corporate ownership tree from each intermediate holding company to the ultimate natural persons; statutory registers of directors and shareholders; passport copies and proof of residential address; a source-of-wealth letter supported by audited financial statements of the offshore parent; bank reference letters from the parent's primary relationship bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FDI capital injection amount is funded through third-party intermediary accounts, raising concerns over circular flows and violation of SAFE capital account verification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Direct SWIFT MT103 from the declared foreign shareholder's bank account to the WFOE's FDI capital account; board resolution and approved investment plan; signed equity subscription agreement; source-of-funds evidence including bank deposits and profit reserves; CPA-issued capital verification report within one month of injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business scope of 3PL kitting triggers negative perception of lack of substantive operations because of high transaction velocity and low asset intensity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for a warehousing facility with at least 12 months term; inventory receiving and picking records; labour service contracts and social insurance payments for at least 5 operational staff; logistics and distribution agreements with e-commerce clients; VAT invoices for purchased packaging materials and sold kitting services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border trade counterparties include jurisdictions under enhanced monitoring or sanctions hotspots, elevating the transaction risk rating.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed AML counterparty due-diligence forms; public registry extracts of the counterparties; transaction flow charts with value and logistics bridging documents; sanctions and adverse media screening reports from a reputable screening tool; underlying sales contract, packing list, customs declaration and tax invoice for each transaction to substantiate the trade pattern.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity injection for the WFOE must be remitted through SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident shareholder's offshore bank account to the WFOE's dedicated FDI capital account held at the chosen domestic bank. The remittance instruction must cite SAFE's FDI registration code and the exact purpose code for equity injection. On receipt, the bank must settle the conversion against a current account or perform direct RMB settlement with the CPA verification report; the entity cannot set off any offshore expenses or pending receivables against the capital contribution. Capital funds must be placed in an escrow-like supervision account and can only be used for the declared business after capital verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments and trade settlements will be executed over SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for direct transfers; for larger or postponed-payment arrangements, an irrevocable documentary letter of credit or documentary collection may be opened via the same branch rail. The WFOE must present underlying trade documents (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, customs declarations and inspection certificates) so the bank can perform matching against the goods trade monitoring system and release outward remittance. Same-day netting or commingling of operational and capital fungible flows is not permitted.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable foreign exchange forward contracts against RMB with genuine trade or capital exposure and bank-verified supporting documents
Cross-currency swap (CCS) for matching external loan liabilities and long-term trade settlement flows, subject to SAFE real-demand authentication
Currency basis swaps for onshore-offshore funding cost management, prohibited for speculative profit motive and must be covered by balanced cashflow forecasts

Offshore NDF overlay permitted only if executed through an onshore bank's offshore branch or licensed international vehicle; direct onshore NDF access is not available for non-financial corporates under current SAFE rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June of each calendar year covering the preceding financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the report is not published by 30 June, SAMR places the company on the Enterprise Operating Anomaly List within 10 working days after the deadline; this status restricts credit, licensing changes, and government incentives. If the anomaly remains unremedied for three consecutive years, the company is moved to the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List and the licensing authority may administratively revoke the business license. Submitting false or misleading annual report information may attract an administrative fine in the range of RMB 5,000 to RMB 10,000, with aggravating penalties up to RMB 30,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement and Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) local in-charge tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 May of the following calendar year for the preceding fiscal year (five months after the annual closing date)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a procedural fine of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 per the Tax Administration Law, or up to RMB 50,000 for serious cases. Any unpaid balance of corporate income tax accrues daily late-payment interest at 0.05% of the overdue amount, starting from 1 June. Persistent non-payment may lead to enforced tax collection measures, freezing of bank accounts, attachment and auction of assets, restriction on outbound transitions, and a tax-evasion penalty ranging from 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAMR jointly with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) under the Foreign Investment Law reporting mechanism
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the annual enterprise information report, 1 January to 30 June each year; any shareholding change within the year must be reported within 30 days from the date of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, or filing false or concealed information, triggers a rectification order from the commerce authority; if not rectified within the prescribed period, a fine of up to RMB 200,000 may be imposed. Continuing non-reporting is recorded in the enterprise credit file, which can block foreign-exchange registrations, profit repatriation, equity transfers, and tax refunds, and may ultimately contribute to administrative strike-off action.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under PRC Company Law, every limited liability company, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, must have its annual financial statements audited by a lawfully registered accounting firm; there is no quantitative turnover, total-asset, or headcount exemption. For financial-reporting framework classification, an entity is generally regarded as a small enterprise under the SME classification rules when it has annual operating revenue below RMB 30 million, total assets below RMB 30 million, and fewer than 300 employees; such an enterprise may elect the simplified Small Enterprise Accounting Standards but remains subject to the mandatory statutory audit. Separately, the 'small low-profit enterprise' tax threshold (annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million, employees not exceeding 300, and total assets not exceeding RMB 50 million) only grants corporate income tax preferential treatment and does not remove the independent audit obligation. Any enterprise exceeding the small-enterprise indicators, or applying for financing, government bidding, tax refunds, or public offering, must apply full China Accounting Standards and submit a certified audit report.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards (CAS), issued by the Ministry of Finance and substantially converged with IFRS, are mandatory for WFOEs. Medium and large enterprises, or any enterprise exceeding the small-enterprise thresholds, must apply full CAS. Qualifying small enterprises may adopt the 'Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises (2013 Edition)', but unmodified IFRS or US GAAP are not acceptable for PRC statutory filing purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The PRC does not impose a separate annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner return form. Under the People's Bank of China Beneficial Ownership Information Management Measures, a WFOE must initially file beneficial ownership information with SAMR and must update that information within 30 days of any change, including transfers of shares or changes in the ultimate controlling party. In parallel, the annual enterprise information report filed by 30 June must confirm the current shareholders, actual controller, and ownership-chain composition as of the preceding year-end. Failure to maintain accurate beneficial-owner records may lead to credit anomaly listing, restrictions in banking relationships, and penalties under the Beneficial Ownership Information Management Measures and the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Rules.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Legal Representative and Senior Management
Minute Books for Shareholders' Resolutions and Board Resolutions
Register of Share Transfers and Share Pledges
Statutory Accounting Books, Annual Financial Statements and Audit Reports

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 to USD 6,000 per annum for registered-office arrangement or virtual address in tier-2/tier-3 cities; USD 8,000 to USD 35,000 per annum for a leased physical office satisfying the registered-address requirements in tier-1 business areas; WFOEs do not use a registered agent, but corporate secretarial outsourcing may cost USD 2,000 to USD 8,000 per year.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 to USD 10,000 for a low-risk fulfillment and kitting WFOE with simple cash flow and fewer than 300 transactions per month; USD 10,000 to USD 25,000 when full CAS restatement, transfer-pricing documentation, consolidation, or inventory sampling procedures are required.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory headline CIT rate is 25%. Preferential incentives relevant to a Chinese WFOE include: 15% rate for Certified High-New Technology Enterprises; 15% rate for encouraged industries in the Hainan Free Trade Port; an effective 5% rate for qualified Small Low-Profit Enterprises with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million, total assets not exceeding RMB 50 million, and employees not exceeding 300, currently available until 31 December 2027; 100% additional deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; and an extended 10-year loss carryforward for high-tech enterprises and technology-oriented small and medium-sized enterprises. The general loss carryforward period is 5 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return Form A100000 (with adjustment schedules A105000, A105050, A105080 and related appendices), filed through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax electronic filing system at the relevant provincial tax authority portal. Quarterly provisional prepayments are filed on Form A200000 through the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual reconciliation with quarterly provisional prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Form A100000 is due by 31 May following the close of the fiscal year (calendar year). Quarterly prepayments on Form A200000 are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 / Line 1 - Total revenue (营业收入)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from the WFOE's fulfillment, kitting, assembly, warehousing, and third-party logistics services, plus all other operating revenue from both domestic and cross-border customers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Chinese WFOE is a Chinese tax resident enterprise and must declare worldwide income. All service charges billed to non-resident affiliates must be recognized at the arm's length price supported by a contemporaneous transfer pricing analysis. Artificial deferral of revenue, offshore side-letters, rebates, or diverted receivables into a related foreign treasury account will be restated with interest and penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 / Line 2 - Cost of sales (营业成本)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs attributable to revenue, including raw materials, imported components, direct labor, contract assembly charges, warehouse rent, inbound freight, and manufacturing/kitting overheads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cost of sales must be substantiated with invoices, customs records, and assembly documentation. Imported related-party component prices must satisfy the arm's length standard using CUP or TNMM. Inflated costs from related-party procurement are a classic profit-stripping red flag and will trigger an adjustment under EIT Law Article 41.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 / Line 3 - Business taxes and surcharges (税金及附加)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible taxes and surcharges other than income tax, including urban construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge, stamp duty, and property tax, determined on top of VAT obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must separate its own VAT/surcharge positions from those of non-resident counterparties. Where imported services are subject to Chinese VAT withholding, the WFOE must obtain a valid withholding voucher and comply with the service import VAT declaration. The balance of deductible surcharges must reconcile to actual VAT paid; fictitious surcharge accruals are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 / Line 4 - Selling expenses (销售费用)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales commissions, overseas marketing fees, advertising, distribution logistics marketing, and sales staff costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Commissions and marketing fees paid to an offshore sales affiliate are deductible only if genuine services are actually rendered, there is a written service agreement, the fee is arm's length, and the affiliate has the capacity and economic substance to perform the service. Fees paid to a shell intermediary, without personnel or risk assumption, are disallowed and may trigger withholding tax on the deemed cross-border service fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 / Line 5 - Administrative expenses (管理费用)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Management, HR, IT, accounting, legal, and head-office-related overhead incurred inside the Chinese WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees from a foreign parent or group head-office are non-deductible unless the parent provides actual services, the services are documented, and the fee allocation is based on benefit received. Under SAT Announcement 2017 No. 6, a foreign parent charge with no economic substance is treated as a disallowed expense and may be recharacterized as a dividend subject to 10% WHT. The WFOE must retain board minutes, service reports, and detailed cost allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 / Line 6 - Finance expenses (财务费用)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest expense, bank charges, foreign exchange losses, and financing-related expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to foreign related parties is deductible only at arm's length and within the thin capitalization safe harbor, generally a 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio for non-financial enterprises. Excessive related-party interest is non-deductible and may be recharacterized as a hidden dividend, giving rise to 10% withholding tax and late-payment surcharge. The WFOE must also demonstrate that the loan has genuine commercial purpose and is not a disguised capital contribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 / Line 14 - Total profit (利润总额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory accounting profit before tax, derived from the profit and loss statement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the starting point for all tax adjustments. The WFOE must reconcile the accounting profit to the CIT assessment. Transactions with foreign affiliates, especially below-cost sales of kitting services or excessive head-office allocations, must be adjusted to arm's length in the A105000 schedule before Line 14 flows to taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 / Line 21 - Taxable income (应纳税所得额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after tax adjustments, tax-exempt income, deductions, overseas loss relief, and carried-forward tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE may offset taxable income with losses carried forward for 5 years (10 years for qualified high-tech enterprises). A WFOE that persistently reports zero or near-zero taxable income while the offshore group earns high consolidated margins will attract mandatory transfer pricing audit. The tax authority may demand a full local file, master file, and country-by-country report; failure to cooperate triggers special tax adjustment interest plus a 5 percentage point penalty surcharge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 / Line 23 - CIT payable at 25% (应纳所得税额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax liability computed by applying the statutory rate to taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This line does not include withholding tax on dividends to non-resident shareholders. The WFOE, as a withholding agent, separately reports and pays 10% WHT on gross dividends paid to non-resident beneficial owners unless a tax treaty reduces the rate and the proper treaty application is approved.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 / Lines 24-26 - Tax reductions, foreign tax credits, and balance due or refund (减免所得税额 / 抵免所得税额 / 应补退税额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claimed preferential reductions, credits, and the final balance payable or refundable after quarterly prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE should claim only verified incentives, such as the high-tech enterprise 15% rate, small-profit enterprise effective 5% rate, or foreign tax credits for overseas taxed branch income. In a cross-border context, if treaty relief is applied to reduce WHT on a dividend, the WFOE must hold the non-resident shareholder's Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership declaration before filing the withholding return; otherwise the 10% rate must be withheld.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual filing is punishable under Tax Collection Law Article 62 by an order to correct and a fine of RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 in serious cases, with criminal referral for fraudulent non-filing. Late payment of CIT incurs a daily surcharge of 0.05% under Article 32. Understating income or fabricating expenses is tax evasion under Article 63, leading to recovery of the evaded tax plus 50% to 5 times the evaded amount. A withholding agent that fails to withhold WHT on an outbound dividend is penalized under Article 69 in an amount equal to 50% to 3 times the unwithheld tax. If the evaded amount reaches the criminal threshold under Criminal Law Article 201 (generally RMB 50,000 or more and exceeding 10% of the assessable taxable base), the responsible individuals may face imprisonment of up to 3 years; for huge amounts and a tax-evasion ratio above 30%, imprisonment of 3 to 7 years and fines may be imposed. Serious tax violations also result in publication on the State Taxation Administration's serious tax violation blacklist and exit-bans for directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax under EIT Law Article 3(3) and Article 37 on gross dividends paid by the Chinese WFOE to a non-resident enterprise that has no establishment or place of business in China. Treaty relief may reduce this rate, commonly to 5% for a beneficial owner that is a company directly holding at least 25% of the WFOE and satisfying all anti-abuse conditions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim bilateral Double Tax Agreement relief, the WFOE as withholding agent must first obtain from the non-resident shareholder: (i) an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the competent authority of the shareholder's residence jurisdiction for the relevant calendar year; (ii) a beneficial ownership declaration confirming that the shareholder is not a conduit or pass-through entity; and (iii) supporting documentation establishing substantive business activity, board authorization, ownership structure, and absence of arrangement whose main purpose is treaty abuse. The WFOE must file the non-resident withholding and treaty benefit application through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax system before making the reduced-rate remittance, and must retain the TRC and underlying evidence for 10 years. Where the tax authority denies treaty relief, the remaining 10% WHT plus late surcharge and interest may be assessed and, in abusive structures, a General Anti-Avoidance Rule adjustment under EIT Law Article 47 may apply.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on interest and royalties paid by the Chinese WFOE to non-resident enterprises is 10%. Under the Mainland-Hong Kong Double Tax Arrangement, interest and royalties payable to a Hong Kong beneficial owner may be capped at 7%; other DTAs can provide similar relief, but the same Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership, and substance requirements apply. Royalties paid for intangibles that are merely ninja-lived in an offshore holding company, or paid to a related party that does not conduct active management and development of the intellectual property, are vulnerable to denial and recharacterization as non-deductible dividends.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under SAT Announcement 2016 No. 42, contemporaneous local file documentation is mandatory for the WFOE when annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 200 million for tangible asset transfers, RMB 100 million for intangible asset transfers, RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers, or RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions. A master file is required when the enterprise's annual related-party transaction amount exceeds RMB 1 billion. Country-by-Country reporting is required for Ultimate Parent Entities in China whose consolidated group revenue for the prior fiscal year exceeded RMB 5.5 billion. The foreign-exchange and tax authorities may also demand an arm's length statement for any significant cross-border related-party receivable or payable.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Mainland China does not operate the offshore 'Economic Substance Regulations' regime found in certain zero-tax jurisdictions, but applies a robust economic substance and anti-avoidance doctrine embedded in EIT Law Article 41 (related-party transactions), Article 45 (controlled foreign corporations), Article 46 (thin capitalization), Article 47 (General Anti-Avoidance Rule), and Article 48. The State Taxation Administration will disregard an arrangement that lacks commercial purpose and will attribute taxable profits to the Chinese entity where the Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) for fulfillment/kitting/assembly are in China. A qualifying WFOE must demonstrate local personnel, operational control, inventory and pricing risk, purchase orders, warehouse and assembly execution, invoicing, and profit-relevant decision-making. A letterbox WFOE with no CIGA, no staff, and no operational substance can be recharacterized and have its income re-attributed to a non-resident principal, exposing the WFOE to additional tax, interest, and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-declaration of fulfillment revenue, diversion of customer receipts to foreign or personal bank accounts, destruction of kitting/warehouse records, and issuance or receipt of false special VAT invoices to inflate deductible costs in the Chinese WFOE.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Collection Law Article 63 requires recovery of the evaded CIT and imposes a fine of 50% to 5 times the evaded amount plus a 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge under Article 32. Criminal Law Article 201 criminalizes tax evasion; if the evaded amount reaches the criminal threshold and the ratio to taxable income is serious, the responsible individual may be sentenced to up to 3 years' imprisonment, and for huge evaded amounts with a ratio above 30%, 3 to 7 years' imprisonment plus fines. False VAT invoice behavior is also punishable under Criminal Law Article 205, with potential life imprisonment in extreme cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly order or facilitate fraudulent accounting may have the corporate veil pierced under Company Law Article 20 and relevant judicial precedent; they are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and civil restitution out of personal assets. Tax authorities may freeze personal bank accounts, attach director property, place the director on the serious tax violation blacklist, and impose travel bans through the exit restriction mechanism. Criminal prosecution may lead to a personal prison sentence for the director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Evasion and Disguised Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends to a non-resident parent without withholding the statutory 10% WHT; disguising a dividend as an interest-free shareholder loan that is later forgiven; routing a dividend through a Hong Kong or other treaty conduit without beneficial ownership or economic substance; and distributing profits while the Chinese WFOE remains in liquidation without setting aside the WHT liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Article 37 imposes WHT, and Tax Collection Law Article 69 penalizes the WFOE as withholding agent for a sum equal to 50% to 3 times the unwithheld tax; the tax authority will also demand payment of the unpaid WHT and daily interest. If the conduit arrangement is designed to obtain unintended treaty benefits, EIT Law Article 47 allows the competent authority to deny treaty relief, restore the 10% WHT, and assess late-payment interest. Where the conduct is fraudulent, Criminal Law Article 201 applies to the individuals responsible.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve dividend declarations without reserving WHT may be held personally liable where the corporate entity is rendered insolvent or where the distribution is in substance an asset-stripping device. The civil court may pierce the veil and order directors to restore the WHT plus penalties from personal assets. The directors are also exposed to travel bans, asset freezes, and Chinese 'blacklisting' as dishonest taxpayers; deliberate concealed distributions can result in personal criminal imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and Shell Company Abuse Under the General Anti-Avoidance Rule
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring the Chinese WFOE as a zero-profit contract kitting shell that sells at below-cost to an offshore group company, pays management fees to a Bermuda or Cayman affiliate with no staff, licenses intangibles from an offshore shell while never exercising control over the intangibles, enters into an excessive related-party loan exceeding the 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio, and fails to prepare or file the Chinese local file, master file, or Country-by-Country report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Articles 41, 44, 46, and 47 empower the State Taxation Administration to make an arm's length adjustment, recharacterize financing arrangements, and disregard transactions lacking commercial substance. SAT Announcement 2016 No. 42 and Announcement 2017 No. 6 impose contemporaneous documentation requirements; failure to supply documentation triggers interest on the adjusted tax plus an additional 5 percentage point annual surcharge. The special tax investigation look-back period may extend to 10 years. Non-deductible interest is recharacterized as a dividend subject to 10% WHT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the WFOE is found to be a sham instrument created for profit stripping, the court may pierce the corporate veil and hold the directors jointly and severally liable for the Chinese tax liability. Directors can be ordered to make civil restitution from personal assets, are subject to exit bans and blacklisting, and may face criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 201 if they knowingly signed false statements or concealed taxable income to sustain the fraudulent pricing arrangement. In egregious cases, the responsible director may be imprisoned alongside corporate fines.
